name: pu_classDiagram
description: Generates a PlantUML context diagram for a UML class.  The diagram shows: - The focal class (highlighted) with its own attributes - Associated classes grouped into three sections: (a) direct associated classes that are not superclasses, grouped in a 'together' block for Graphviz layout (b) abstraction supplier classes in a 'together' block (c) remaining context classes - Association arrows for the focal class - Superclass hierarchy (via pu_superClass) with limited inherited associations (max 3 per superclass) - Subclass hierarchy (via pu_subClasses) - Abstraction relationships when includeAllItems is true  All sections are subject to subset filtering via u_isAssociationInSubset (for associations) and u_profileSubsetClasses (for class nodes) when 'profiles' is true.  The diagram is @enduml-terminated and output as a complete standalone PlantUML file.
params: aClass - The UML class for which the context diagram is generated. aSubsetPackage - The profile sub-package whose dependency relationships define the active subset, or null for universe (no profile filtering).

name: pu_dataTypeDiagram
description: Generates a PlantUML context diagram for a UML data type.  The diagram shows: - The focal data type (highlighted) with its own attributes - Classes and data types that use this type as an attribute type, grouped by package, with dotted usage connections - Supertype inheritance hierarchy (via pu_superDataType) - Subtype inheritance hierarchy (via pu_subDataTypes) - Abstraction relationships  Attribute inclusion and usage connections are subject to subset filtering via u_subsetDataTypeAttributes.
params: aDataType - The UML data type for which the diagram is generated.

name: abstractionType
description: Returns the PlantUML stereotype label for a UML abstraction, derived from the abstraction's name: contains 'derivesFrom' -> <<Derive>> contains 'refines'     -> <<Refine>> contains 'tracesTo'    -> <<Trace>>

name: pu_superClass
description: Renders the superclass hierarchy for the focal class in a context diagram. For each direct superclass (subject to subset filtering):  1. Emits a note if the superclass has more than maxInherited associations, stating how many are shown. 2. Iterates up to maxInherited inherited associations of the superclass (via u_limitedAssociations), rendering each as a PlantUML association arrow using u_isAssociationInSubset for subset filtering and u_commentBody for the tooltip. 3. Renders the superclass node with its attributes. 4. Emits the generalization arrow. 5. Recurses upward via pu_superClass.  The maximum number of inherited associations shown per superclass is controlled by the let binding 'maxInherited'. This local cap prevents diagrams from becoming unreadable when a superclass has many associations.
params: aClass - The class whose superclasses are being rendered. mainClass - The original focal class at the root of the recursion, passed through unchanged to allow u_limitedAssociations to exclude the focal class's own direct associations. aSubsetPackage - The profile sub-package, or null for universe.

name: pu_superDataType
description: Renders supertype inheritance for a data type context diagram. For each direct supertype, emits usage connections (dotted lines) for the supertype's limited-use properties, the inheritance arrow, and recurses upward.
params: aDataType - The data type whose supertypes are being rendered.

name: pu_subClasses
description: Renders subclass inheritance arrows recursively for a class context diagram. Each subclass is subject to subset filtering via u_profileSubsetClasses when 'profiles' is true. Recurses into each subclass's own subclasses.
params: aClass - The class whose subclasses are being rendered. aSubsetPackage - The profile sub-package, or null for universe.

name: pu_subDataTypes
description: Renders subtype inheritance arrows recursively for a data type context diagram. Recurses into each subtype's own subtypes.
params: aDataType - The data type whose subtypes are being rendered.

name: rst_processAttributeInTable
description: Generates a table row in RST list-table format for a single class or data type attribute. The row is subject to subset filtering. Columns: attribute name, owning classifier reference, description, type reference, multiplicity, and default value.
params: anAttribute - The UML property (attribute) to render. aClassifier - The classifier owning the attribute's diagram.

name: rst_refDataType
description: Generates a RST :ref: link for a UML type. UML primitive types (Boolean, Integer, Real, String) are rendered as plain text; all other types are rendered as a :ref: cross-reference.
params: aType - A UML type to reference.

name: rst_processAssociationInTable
description: Generates a table row in RST list-table format for a single UML association. Columns: target multiplicity, association predicate (short name), source class reference with qualified name, source multiplicity.
params: a - The UML association to render. indent - Indentation string to prepend to each RST list item.

name: rst_simpleQualifiedClassNameReference
description: Generates a RST :ref: cross-reference for a class, using the simple qualified classifier name as the visible label and the fully qualified name as the reference target.
params: aClass - A UML class to cross-reference.

name: rst_simpleQualifiedClassifierNameReference
description: Generates a RST :ref: cross-reference for a classifier, using the simple qualified classifier name as the visible label and the fully qualified name as the reference target.
params: aClassifier - A UML classifier to cross-reference.

name: rst_classNameReference
description: Generates a RST :ref: cross-reference for a class using only the fully qualified name (no visible label override).
params: aClass - A UML class to cross-reference.

name: rst_classifierNameReference
description: Generates a RST :ref: cross-reference for a classifier using only the fully qualified name (no visible label override).
params: aClassifier - A UML classifier to cross-reference.

name: rst_className
description: Renders a class name in RST, wrapping it in italic emphasis markers when the class is abstract.

name: e_indent
description: Post-processing template that prefixes every non-empty line of a multi-line string with a fixed number of spaces. Used to produce RST-indented include blocks when a generated diagram is embedded in an RST file.
params: s - The string to indent. indentAmount - The number of leading spaces to add per line.

name: e_indent2
description: Post-processing template that inserts a fixed indentation string after every newline character in a string. Complementary to e_indent for use within a string value rather than on block boundaries.
params: s - The string to indent. indent - The number of leading spaces to insert after each newline.

name: rst_classOrDataTypeInheritance
description: Generates the RST inheritance tree section for a classifier, rendered as a collapsible dropdown. The tree shows all superclass ancestors from the root downward to the focal class, followed by all direct and indirect subclasses.  When the classifier has superclasses, the root ancestor appears first without indentation and each subsequent ancestor is indented by 4 em-spaces per level, with the focal class shown in :focus:. When the classifier has no superclasses but does have subclasses, only the focal class and its subtree are shown.
params: aClassifier - The UML classifier for which the inheritance tree is generated.

name: rst_subClasses
description: Generates a recursive RST subclass/subtype list for the inheritance tree dropdown. Each entry is rendered with appropriate CSS class (abstract or regular) and indented by the given indent string. Recurses into each child's own subtree.  When 'profiles' is true, only subclasses/subtypes that are members of the dependency-defined profile subset are shown (checked by object identity via u_profileSubsetClasses for classes and u_profileSubsetDataTypes for data types). When 'includeAllItems' is true, all subclasses and subtypes are shown regardless of the subset.
params: aClassifier - The classifier whose children are listed. indent - The current indentation prefix string.

name: diagramModalPreCode
description: Generates the opening HTML markup for the SVG diagram modal container. The modal allows the diagram to be enlarged and pan/zoomed in the browser. Must be paired with diagramModalPostCode.
params: anOclAny - Any EObject; used only as receiver for dispatch.

name: diagramModalPostCode
description: Generates the closing HTML markup for the SVG diagram modal, including the modal overlay, pan/zoom controls, and download buttons for PNG and SVG export.
params: anOclAny - Any EObject; used only as receiver for dispatch.

name: rst_addClassReferencesToDocumentation
description: Injects RST :ref: cross-references into a documentation string for every class in aClassSequence whose name appears as a word boundary followed by punctuation in the string. Recurses through the sequence one class at a time.
params: s - The documentation string to process. aClass - The class being documented (excluded from self-reference injection). aClassSequence - The sequence of classes to inject as :ref:.
